summary: Public regression testing completed: backend suite passed 6/6, optimized frontend build passed, and browser smoke covered authenticated workspace, WebSocket status, messaging, friends/DM search, rules panel, voice mute/screen/leave, mobile overflow, and page error selectors. One desktop composer interaction is blocked by the fixed global tools overlay.

critical.issue: Code review finding remains: action=kick deletes a ban record instead of removing the target community membership, so Expulsar has no effect.

ui_bugs.issue: At desktop width, the fixed Amigos/DMs and Regras toolbar overlaps the right side of the composer and intercepts pointer events, making the send button unclickable. Keyboard Enter still sends.

integration_issues.issue: The add voice-room control still has no click handler; only the seeded lounge opens a voice modal.

action_items: Move or constrain the fixed global tools toolbar so it does not cover the composer/send button at desktop widths.
Fix moderation kick to remove membership or enforce an explicit expelled state.
Wire add-voice-room to room creation or remove/disable the control until supported.
critical_code_review_comments: Moderation kick and unban share an incorrect ban-deletion path; kick currently cannot expel a member.
The global-tools fixed positioning has insufficient bottom/right spacing relative to the composer and blocks pointer input.
seed_data_creation: Existing regression tests created disposable TEST_ users, communities, channels, DMs, and WebSocket sessions through public APIs; browser used the documented test account and sent disposable messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend social/rules/invite/DM/auth/WebSocket regression is green. UI panels and voice controls pass; retest composer clickability after moving global tools, then verify moderation kick and add-voice-room behavior.
rca of the issue: The composer is underneath a fixed .global-tools element at the same bottom region; CSS stacking/pointer hit testing lets the toolbar intercept the send button. The moderation defect is a backend branch implementation error: kick deletes bans rather than community_members. The voice creation issue is a missing onClick/business flow on add-voice-room-button. No APIs were mocked.
